title: File:House number sign in Dehibolo 2021.jpg
description: Number sign of the house in Dehibolo, Uzbekistan, where Mustafo Zokirovič Holmominov once lived, the first known explorer of the Boybuloq cave. Homes in the village were furnished with house number signs of three lines with DEHIBOLO MFY O'ZBEKISTAN (Dehibolo Neighborhood Uzbekistan) in the first line, "STREET NAME" "STREET NUMBER" in the main, second line and KO'CHASI UY (street No.) in the third line. Taken by Primož Jakopin on August 19, 2021. Photo ID in the P. Jakopin photo archive is PJ5042
